100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On September 23, 1926, the British Empire faced turmoil as a general strike in South Wales gained momentum, drawing attention to miners' demands for better wages and working conditions. In the United States, a new wave of Prohibition enforcement was underway, as authorities intensified raids on speakeasies and illegal breweries. Meanwhile, in Germany, political tensions escalated as the Nazi Party continued to gain traction amidst a struggling economy and rising discontent.
